goal: Implement portable watchdog templates and a Codex-only two-heartbeat adapter with safe lifecycle guardrails.
architectureSummary: Portable provider/profile selector in the registry; materialized .super-planning/watchdogs config and prompts; generic adapter contract; Codex same-thread continuation and read-only status roles; host IDs only in ignored local metadata.
globalConstraints: Watchdogs are explicit opt-in and disabled by default.
Materialize provider config under .super-planning/watchdogs without host IDs, credentials, or transcripts.
Status is same-thread, read-only, and may interrupt active work.
Never bypass lifecycle, dependency, worktree, review, or human-decision gates.
Pause every role for a human block and disable every role at completed/cancelled.
Preserve unrelated realtime-dashboard and existing super-planning changes.
The user explicitly authorized implementation directly on main without a worktree.

fileStructure.notes: Writes deterministic target-repository config and prompts.

requirementsChecklist.title: Persist a disabled portable watchdog selector compatibly.
acceptanceCriteria: Legacy registries without continuation validate.
New registries default to disabled Codex/default-profile policy.
Invalid selector data is rejected.

requirementsChecklist.title: Provide generic adapter/config templates and a Codex-only implementation.

acceptanceCriteria: Future providers start from a generic template.

No host IDs enter versioned artifacts.

requirementsChecklist.title: Require explicit consent and valid profile selection before scheduling.
acceptanceCriteria: Declining creates no automation.
Phase 5 validates provider and profile.
Continuation preserves all normal lifecycle gates.

requirementsChecklist.title: Operate two same-thread Codex watchdog roles safely.
requirementsChecklist.source: accepted spec: Codex adapter; Edge cases
acceptanceCriteria: Status is read-only and never becomes a cron.
Human blocks pause every role.
Completed and cancelled plans disable every role.

requirementsChecklist.title: Verify and publish portable watchdog capability.
requirementsChecklist.source: accepted spec: Definition of Done; Test Strategy
acceptanceCriteria: Focused tests/evals cover policy, materialization, and lifecycle.
Build ships all new skill artifacts.
Spec closure records real evidence only.

rules: super-plan.json is orchestrator-owned; workers do not edit it directly.
Execute tasks sequentially and review each completed batch independently.
Record RED and GREEN evidence for behavior changes.
Use rtk as the workspace command prefix.
The user authorized direct integration on main over overlapping pre-existing dirty changes; review only watchdog-scoped behavior and preserve unrelated work.
Requested profiles are deepExecutor=gpt-5.6-terra/medium and all other roles=gpt-5.6-luna/medium; current dispatch may fall back when model pinning is unavailable.
